question: What is the meaning of hazardous substances in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Hazardous substances in relation to health and safety aspects refer to substances that pose risks to human health and the environment. These substances can include carcinogenic, mutagenic, toxic to reproduction, endocrine disruptors, toxic to specific organs, and those affecting respiratory and skin health. Additionally, hazardous substances can also be persistent, bioaccumulative, toxic, very persistent, very bioaccumulative, hazardous to the aquatic environment, and hazardous to the ozone layer.
